1.explanation: This snippet creates a “skeleton” breadcrumb just like the Storybook example in Carbon React. Each step is rendered as an anchor containing only the SkeletonPlaceholder (a div with class "bx--skeleton__placeholder"). Because the anchors do not have any text or images with alt text inside them, the IBM Accessibility DAP rule “Hyperlinks must contain link text or an image with alt text” is triggered for each breadcrumb item.
1.bug_scenario: In the React “Skeleton” variation of the Breadcrumb we render each breadcrumb step as an anchor (<a>) wrapping only a visual placeholder (<div class="bx--skeleton__placeholder">) and divider slashes ("/"). Because the <a> tags have no visible or screen-reader text (and no image with alt text), DAP flags each link as “missing link text or an image with alt text.”
